name: copper
lore_descriptor: ruddy and soft, the metal of beginnings
first_pickup_chronicle: Copper. Soft. It will bend before it breaks — and at the rate this place is going, it will break. But it cuts, for now.
design_notes: Curve-derived: peak F2 spread 5 means weight ~4 at F1-F3, fading by F10. damage_mult 0.7 — softer than iron. max_enchant 1 (cannot bear much magic). Starter metal for the most rural-poor character spawns. Vanishes from the spawn pool by F15. cite: curve.weapon_base_damage(1)=1, so a copper longsword = 1 base × 0.7 mat × 1.0 modifier = ~1 — correct AD&D feel for floor 1.
